basis: 2024-2025 only. 2023 is excluded because the 1 January 2024 dive-count alignment with World Aquatics makes earlier raw scores incomparable for Group A, Group C girls and Group D.
exclusions: Platform (non-qualifying at Regionals in every year). Any meet/event containing a shared place, since a shared place means a tie or a non-displacing athlete and the Nth-place rank is then not a clean bar. Fields with fewer than 15 finishers. Athletes whose competition result could not be matched to a membership record with a zip code are excluded from county attribution (94.1% matched) -- not silently dropped from awareness, but they cannot be placed on the map.
notes: cellsByCounty is keyed by home county (from membership zip) -- use this for any boundary/area redraw, since it answers 'which new area would this athlete fall into.' cellsByRegion is keyed by the region the athlete actually competed in (identical to this file before this rebuild) -- keep using this for anything about today's real regions as drawn. The two do not agree for every athlete BY DESIGN: region choice lets an athlete compete somewhere other than their geography would suggest, and that gap is exactly what regionChoice measures, not an error in either column.
scope: Region-to-Zone gate only. Top 15 per springboard event advance out of Regionals. No other gate is modelled.
